## CREDO HR-Portal — Offboarding Workflow

### 5 Webhook-Events:
1. **offboarding-created** → E-Mail an HR: Neuer Offboarding-Vorgang
2. **offboarding-department-assigned** → E-Mail an Abteilung mit Magic-Link
3. **offboarding-task-completed** → E-Mail an HR: Aufgabe erledigt + Fortschritt
4. **offboarding-department-completed** → E-Mail an HR: Abteilung fertig
5. **offboarding-completed** → E-Mail an HR: Gesamter Vorgang abgeschlossen

### Setup-Checkliste:
- [ ] SMTP-Credential "CREDO Exchange SMTP" anlegen (Exchange-Server)
- [ ] Header Auth Credential anlegen: Name=X-API-Key, Value=<N8N_API_KEY aus .env>
- [ ] Credential-IDs in allen Nodes eintragen
- [ ] Workflow aktivieren
- [ ] Test: Neuen Offboarding-Vorgang im HR-Portal erstellen

### Webhook-URLs (nach Aktivierung):
- https://n8n.credo-intern.de/webhook/offboarding-created
- https://n8n.credo-intern.de/webhook/offboarding-department-assigned
- https://n8n.credo-intern.de/webhook/offboarding-task-completed
- https://n8n.credo-intern.de/webhook/offboarding-department-completed
- https://n8n.credo-intern.de/webhook/offboarding-completed
